verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents the Pipelines and Track APIs for identifying customers and sending real-time profile data (create/update). Suppression is explicit via a 'Suppress Person' event, and deletion via 'Delete Person'. A published OpenAPI spec and Postman collection support developer use. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of setting custom profile attributes via API, evidence of production-scale behavior (rate limits, batch endpoints, throughput), and independent hands-on corroboration.
